news.text: "#Conte? It Is Normal To Hope"#Spalletti pre #Juve-#VeneziaLucio with #KoloMuani and #Alajbegović behind #Woltemade (12:30 PM)[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

LUCIO AND #CONTE ON THE #JUVE RING#Spalletti's reply fires up the clash with #VeneziaThe bianconero manager after Antonio's self-nomination: "It is normal for an unemployed manager to hope to sit on an important bench like that of la Nazionale, #Milan, #ManchesterUnited, #Juventus... Would I have spoken like that too? When I was out of work, I used to go watch my colleagues to learn. #McKennie? He came to clear the air". For #Alajbegović, the boost from Ibra.[Front Page TuttoSport]
🔴 Probable #Juventus lineup: Vicario; Gatti, Bremer, Lucumi; McKennie, Douglas Luiz, Koopmeiners, Cabal; Kolo Muani, Alajbegovic; Woltemade.[Sky Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

🦅🧐 "#Taylor is in the sights of Premier League clubs, which could make an offer as early as January. #Lazio values him at least €40M and the price could rise up to €50/60M. In Italy, he is very well liked by #Massara and #Juventus, that can count on good relations with the biancocelesti. #Gattuso, however, does not want any exits in the winter: if anyone wants him, it will potentially be discussed again in the summer."[Nicolò Schira - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

😀⚠️ "Regarding #Juventus, we must pay close attention to potential swap deals that could emerge in January. As for #David-#Sorloth, it remains to be seen whether the move truly serves to make a leap in quality or is merely a way to offload a contract. The preference could be to cash in the €25M."[Alfredo Pedullà - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

We’ve seen some key players return from injury, and we’ve had two good training sessions between yesterday and today. [Jeff] Ekhator is certainly a player to watch. We will discover the future of the bianconero bench over the coming months, also depending on what happens in the second half of the season."[Giovanni Albanese - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

👨‍🦲✅ "Full trust in #Spalletti, at least until the end of the season. The manager does not feel affected by the rumors about #Conte or by his words. The club wants to build from the current certainties, strengthening the squad and the group. They have chosen to go down this path, giving him trust and putting him in the right conditions to work: currently, his position ha never been in question."[Giovanni Albanese - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

📋🧐 "#Spalletti has a switch to a 4-3-3 in mind, but I don't think we will see it already against #Venezia because he lacks the defensive personnel on the flanks. With #Çelik and #Cambiaso not at their best and #Kalulu sidelined, it is much more likely we will see a 3-4-2-1."[Romeo Agresti - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

🇽🇰⁉️ "#Zhegrova's entourage is starting to look around ahead of January. I'm told he is very happy in Turin and with the environment, and he has always behaved professionally, but his limited playing time could lead to some reflection. Therefore the feasibility of a possible sale is being evaluated, should offers arrive. It also remains to be seen what the asking price will be."[Romeo Agresti - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]

😀👀 #Juventus and #AtléticoMadrid continue to work on the #David-#Sorloth swap deal. Both clubs have opened up to the possibility, but the main obstacle concerns the financial valuations: #Juventus is aiming for a straight swap or one with a small cash adjustment in their favor, whereas #AtléticoMadrid is asking for the Canadian + a financial compensation to let the Norwegian leave. A compromise is being sought.[Gazzetta dello Sport via @juventusinsidernews]

🆙❗️#Juventus has identified 5 names for the striker position. The priority is #Sørloth, but the high price makes it complicated: they continue to work on a loan with an option to buy. Another concrete lead is #Varela: #Monza is asking for €35M, but competition is fierce, especially from #Napoli, in addition to English clubs. #Raimondo, #Scamacca and #Balogun (here #Zhegrova could help because #Monaco likes him) also remain under observation.[TuttoSport via @juventusinsidernews]

👀 "#Juventus is looking for a left-back as a priority in the winter mercato session and there are several names on the shortlist:▫️Alejandro #Balde, there are no major confirmations.▪️#Bernasconi could be a name for the future, though he is not a hot target right now.▫️#Miranda is liked, though for now #Bologna is putting up a wall.▪️#Raum is liked, though more of a free transfer move rather than for the short term.▫️Destiny #Udogie, for the short term, an option could open up for a paid loan with an option or obligation to buy.#Udogie would like to to return to Italy to regain visibility for the national team, because for now #Mancini is not factoring him into his plans.Genuine consideratio

UNLUCKY LUCIANOA difficult #JuveDisappointed fans, the team in trouble, the shadow of #Conte.Against #Venezia, #Spalletti seeks three points and consistencyHe is at -6 from the Champions League zone which represents the club's main objective for the season. With the #Woltemade-#Kolo duo, he has improved their attacking output. However, he needs reinforcements.[Front Page Corriere dello Sport]

#UDOGIE-#JUVE AUSILIO SENDS HIMStarting in January, the ex #Inter sporting director will run #Tottenham's mercato: his first move could reinforce #Spalletti's left flank.The bianconero candidacy of the Spurs and Italy wing-back is gaining momentum, helped by the #Vicario and #Sarr deals. Tomorrow against #Venezia, #Kolo and #Woltemade with #Alajbegović. On January 9, on the pitch for #Vialli.Destiny #Udogie, 23 years old: the left-back has been in London since 2023. 12 appearances as an azzurro.[Front Page TuttoSport]

🇮🇹😁 #Juventus is evaluating #Esposito, but #Sassuolo has no intention of letting him go in January: they do not want to weaken the squad mid-season. #Napoli, through Manna, has also already made contact, but the neroverdi's stance is clear: he is not on the mercato and will stay until the end of the season. His future will be evaluated in June.[Andrea Losapio - TuttoJuve via @juventusinsidernews]

⚠️🗣 "#Juventus did not take #Conte's words well: they were not appreciated. If a bond and affection exist, one must also consider the timing. The situation is delicate because the club is in the middle of a still-complicated rebuilding process. I don't rule anything out for the future, but there are different moments and situations in which to speak."[Alfredo Pedullà - YouTube via @juventusinsidernews]
